API reference¶

Flask routes¶

Dynamic Flask analysis page backed by the SQLAlchemy Applicant model.

app.create_app(test_config: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → Flask¶

Create a configurable Flask application without opening a connection.

Tests can replace SESSION_FACTORY, ANALYSIS_RUNNER, and SCRAPE_MANAGER with deterministic doubles. Production uses the Module 3 PostgreSQL and scraper implementations by default.

app.prepare_analysis(results: dict[str, Any]) → dict[str, Any]¶

Convert ORM values to the assignment’s display formats.

Scraping¶

Collect permitted GradCafe results or import saved browser HTML.

class scrape.GradCafeScraper(output: str | Path = 'applicant_data.json', raw_dir: str | Path = 'raw', delay: float = 6.0, timeout: float = 30.0)¶

Checkpoint collection progress and stop on rejected requests.

check_robots(saved_file: Path | None = None) → None¶

Fetch robots.txt or inspect an explicitly supplied browser copy.

Parameters:

saved_file – Optional saved public policy; otherwise request it.

Raises:

ScrapingStopped – The policy is unreadable or denies results.

ensure_live_allowed() → None¶

Refuse new live operations after a saved rejection or block.

Offline replay into separate paths remains possible. This method never clears the saved stop or treats a browser transport as authorization.

ingest(payload: bytes, page: int, source_url: str | None = None, method: str = 'urllib') → int¶

Commit one source page and append previously unseen applicants.

Parameters:

  • payload – Original source HTML bytes.

  • page – Sequential capture number, starting at one.

  • source_url – Actual page URL; legacy callers may omit it.

  • method – Human-readable acquisition method for the manifest.

Returns:

Number of newly added records.

Raises:

ScrapingStopped – Policy, identity, or pagination checks fail.

static next_url(html: str, page_url: str) → str | None¶

Find the site’s actual Next link, including cursor pagination.

Parameters:

  • html – Captured source HTML.

  • page_url – The source page’s absolute URL.

Returns:

An absolute Next URL, or None when no link exists.

parse_html(html: str, page_url: str) → list[dict]¶

Extract applicants from a visible public results table.

Parameters:

  • html – Source HTML captured from the public page.

  • page_url – Actual source URL, including any cursor.

Returns:

Clean applicant dictionaries retaining their raw source text.

Raises:

ScrapingStopped – The page is blocked or has an unknown layout.

record_stop(reason: str) → None¶

Persist a stop reason so a blocked live run cannot retry itself.

Parameters:

reason – The rejection or error that stopped the collector.

resolve_atomic_save_stop(resolution: str) → None¶

Clear a reviewed Windows lock on this collection’s output file.

The saved temporary-file replacement pattern must name the configured output on both sides. Website, parser, policy, and general filesystem failures cannot be cleared through this recovery path.

resolve_browser_transport_stop(resolution: str) → None¶

Clear a reviewed local Chrome connection failure only.

This recovery is intentionally limited to Windows error 10054 and the WebSocket client’s exact remote-host-loss message. Both indicate that the local Chrome DevTools socket closed. HTTP errors, access challenges, rate limits, policy stops, and other failures must remain blocking.

Parameters:

resolution – Human-readable evidence supporting the reviewed retry.

Raises:

ValueError – The saved stop is not the recognized transport error, or no review evidence was supplied.

resolve_parser_stop(resolution: str) → None¶

Clear only a reviewed parser-layout stop after offline validation.

Access denials, challenges, rate limits, and transport failures cannot be cleared through this method.

scrape_data(target: int = 30000, max_pages: int = 5000) → list[dict]¶

Collect permitted pages until the target or a stop is reached.

Parameters:

  • target – Minimum desired number of unique applicant records.

  • max_pages – Maximum sequential captures to consider.

Returns:

All committed applicant records, possibly below the target.

exception scrape.ScrapingStopped¶

A restriction, unexpected response, or unsafe page stops collection.

Load a validated JSON array of applicant dictionaries.

Parameters:

filename – Input JSON path.

Returns:

Applicant records without modifying source values.

scrape.main() → int¶

Run the collection CLI and return its completion/error exit code.

scrape.result_url(page: int) → str¶

Construct a legacy page URL; live collection follows actual Next links.

Parameters:

page – Positive legacy page number.

Returns:

A public HTTPS GradCafe survey URL.

scrape.save_data(data: list[dict], filename: str | Path = 'applicant_data.json') → None¶

Atomically save applicant records to a UTF-8 JSON array.

Parameters:

  • data – Applicant dictionaries to serialize.

  • filename – Destination path relative to the working directory.

scrape.scrape_data(**kwargs) → list[dict]¶

Collect using default files and keyword target/max_pages arguments.

scrape.validate_public_url(url: str) → str¶

Validate a public results or robots URL and remove its fragment.

Parameters:

url – Absolute URL to inspect.

Returns:

The validated URL without a fragment.

Raises:

ScrapingStopped – The URL leaves the permitted public site paths.

Cleaning¶

Clean source text and invoke the instructor’s local LLM package.

clean.clean_data(records: list[dict]) → list[dict]¶

Clean presentation without inferring dates, scores, or outcomes.

Parameters:

records – Extracted applicant dictionaries, including raw fields.

Returns:

New dictionaries with consistent missing values and numeric scores.

clean.extend_with_llm(input_path: Path, output_path: Path, package: Path, batch_size: int = 100, python: str = 'C:\\Users\\DNVR\\Documents\\Hopkins\\Modern Software -- EN.605.256\\jhu_software_concepts\\module_3\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe') → int¶

Run the supplied local app in restartable batches.

The package defines model setup and canonical lists. No API or replacement model is selected. Completed batches are cached by input and package hashes, so changing canonical lists invalidates the cache.

Parameters:

  • input_path – Original applicant JSON array.

  • output_path – Destination for records with added standard fields.

  • package – Directory containing the actual instructor app.py.

  • batch_size – Records per restartable local-model invocation.

  • python – Interpreter with the model dependencies installed.

Returns:

Number of standardized applicant records saved.

Raises:

  • FileNotFoundError – The supplied package is absent.

  • ValueError – Input or model output fails validation.

  • RuntimeError – The supplied model process fails.

clean.main() → int¶

Run the local standardization CLI and return an exit code.

clean.text_value(value: object) → str | None¶

Remove markup/entities and normalize display whitespace.

Parameters:

value – A source value, including None for unavailable information.

Returns:

Clean text or None when no text is available.

Loading¶

Load cleaned GradCafe applicant records into PostgreSQL.

Connection settings use standard PostgreSQL environment variables. If a password is not provided, the program requests it without echoing it.
